no-restricted-syntax.message: Format dates/times/numbers through lib/format.ts (Intl.DateTimeFormat / Intl.NumberFormat with the viewer's locale), not toLocale*String().
Don't hard-code a locale. Use the viewer's locale (useLocale()/getLocale()) via lib/format.ts.
Never build a price by concatenating '$'. Use formatMoney() from lib/format.ts (Intl.NumberFormat, USD, viewer's locale).
Don't hard-code a price string. Use formatMoney(amount, locale) from lib/format.ts.
Don't hard-code a price in JSX text. Use formatMoney(amount, locale) from lib/format.ts.
